field.label: Enabled
field.help: Enable or disable this individual ingress rule without deleting it from the locally-managed tunnel definition.

field.label: Hostname
field.help: Public hostname served by Cloudflare for this origin, for example app.example.com.

field.label: Service Type
field.help: Protocol expected by the origin service behind the tunnel, such as HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, SSH, or RDP.

field.label: Origin URL
field.help: Local origin target that cloudflared should reach for this rule, for example http://127.0.0.1:8080 or tcp://127.0.0.1:22.
